title: Synthesis, Structural Characterization, Cytotoxicity, and Protein/DNA Binding Properties of Pyridoxylidene-Aminoguanidine-Metal (Fe, Co, Zn, Cu) Complexes.
authors: Jevtovic, Violeta; Alhar, Munirah Sulaiman Othman; Milenkovic, Dejan; Markovic, Zoran; Dimitric Markovic, Jasmina; Dimic, Dusan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吡哆醛缩氨基胍金属配合物的合成、表征及其与血清白蛋白和DNA的结合性质，虽涉及蛋白/DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是金属配合物化学性质与细胞毒性，非TF-DNA互作体系，方法上仅用分子对接，缺乏AI或MD深度建模。
abstract: Pyridoxylidene-aminoguanidine (PLAG) and its transition metal complexes are biologically active compounds with interesting properties. In this contribution, three new metal-PLAG complexes, Zn(PLAG)(SO(4))(H(2)O)].∙H(2)O (Zn-PLAG), [Co(PLAG)(2)]SO(4)∙2H(2)O (Co-PLAG), and [Fe(PLAG)(2)]SO(4)∙2H(2)O) (Fe-PLAG), were synthetized and characterized by the X-ray crystallography. The intermolecular interactions governing the stability of crystal structure were compared to those of Cu(PLAG)(NCS)(2) (Cu-PLAG) within Hirshfeld surface analysis. The structures were optimized at B3LYP/6-31+G(d,p)(H,C,N,O,S)/LanL2DZ (Fe,Co,Zn,Cu), and stability was assessed through Natural Bond Orbital Theory and Quantum Theory of Atoms in Molecules. Special emphasis was put on investigating the ligand's stability and reactivity. The binding of these compounds to Bovine and Human serum albumin was investigated by spectrofluorometric titration. The importance of complex geometry and various ligands for protein binding was shown. These results were complemented by the molecular docking study to elucidate the most important interactions. The thermodynamic parameters of the binding process were determined. The binding to DNA, as one of the main pathways in the cell death cycle, was analyzed by molecular docking. The cytotoxicity was determined towards HCT116, A375, MCF-7, and A2780 cell lines. The most active compound was Cu-PLAG due to the presence of PLAG and two thiocyanate ligands.
abstract_zh: 吡哆醛缩氨基胍（PLAG）及其过渡金属配合物是具有有趣性质的生物活性化合物。在本研究中，合成了三种新的金属-PLAG配合物，即Zn(PLAG)(SO(4))(H(2)O)]·H(2)O (Zn-PLAG)、[Co(PLAG)(2)]SO(4)·2H(2)O (Co-PLAG)和[Fe(PLAG)(2)]SO(4)·2H(2)O) (Fe-PLAG)，并通过X射线晶体学对其进行了表征。通过Hirshfeld表面分析，将控制晶体结构稳定性的分子间相互作用与Cu(PLAG)(NCS)(2) (Cu-PLAG)进行了比较。结构在B3LYP/6-31+G(d,p)(H,C,N,O,S)/LanL2DZ (Fe,Co,Zn,Cu)水平下进行了优化，并通过自然键轨道理论和原子分子量子理论评估了稳定性。特别关注了配体的稳定性和反应性研究。通过荧光分光光度滴定法研究了这些化合物与牛血清白蛋白和人血清白蛋白的结合。结果表明了配合物几何结构和不同配体对蛋白质结合的重要性。这些结果通过分子对接研究加以补充，以阐明最重要的相互作用。确定了结合过程的热力学参数。通过分子对接分析了与DNA的结合，这是细胞死亡周期中的主要途径之一。测定了对HCT116、A375、MCF-7和A2780细胞系的细胞毒性。最活跃的化合物是Cu-PLAG，这归因于PLAG和两个硫氰酸根配体的存在。
